subject: Treasure Chest Trick
text: Chest contents are determined when opened: with your item inventory full but room in equipment inventory, repeatedly attempting to open a dropped chest will eventually yield Samurai Armor, Samurai Helmet, or Aegis Shield instead of an item.

evidence.quote:
What is in a treasure chest is not determined when the chest appears,
but instead when you open it. This fact can be taken advantage of when
trying to get the Samurai Armor/Helmet and Aegis Shield. First, you must
have your item inventory full, but still have room in your Equipment
inventory. Then kill the monster carrying the equipment you want until
one of them drops a chest. Then try to open the chest. You will get a
few "Can't carry!" messages, but the chest will remain closed. Eventually
you will get armor instead of an item.

subject: Ice Magic Cave Warp
text: In the corner room right before Ice magic in the cave where you get Ice magic, equip a sword with max will, slide on the two plates and do the max-move to the right, then hold left while flying back to warp to the cave where you get the star.

evidence.quote:
Warp 2- In the cave where you get the Ice magic, go to the corner room
right before you get the Ice magic. Equip a sword, and put your will to
the max. While sliding on the two plates, do the max-move to the right.
Press left when you're flying back, and keep pressing left. You'll warp
to the cave where you get the star.

subject: Wendel Woods Warp
text: In the woods west of Wendel on the bottom road where roads intersect, face west at the western screen limit with an axe and non-full limit gauge, then attack left while moving to the left screen to warp to the snowy fields.

evidence.quote:
Warp 3- In the woods west of Wendel, there is one screen where a road
runs west to south and another road runs west to east on top of it. On
the bottom road, face west. Equip any ax and go to the western limit of
the screen. Make sure your limit gage is NOT full and attack to the
left, at the same time moving to the left screen. You'll warp to the
snowy fields.

subject: Last Dungeon Warp
text: On the top screen of the long zig-zag road in the last dungeon, stand at the farthest point without entering the forest-like area and repeatedly press up, press select while moving one step quickly, then save and reset to warp to the fire cave or enter the snowy fields cave with the Chocobo.

evidence.quote:
Warp 4/5- In the last dungeon, there is a long zig-zag road. On the top
screen, stand on the farthest place you can go without entering the
forest-like place. Repeat the following until you go over the top of
the screen and warp to the fire cave. 1. press up 2. press "select"
while you're moving one step. (do this quickly) 3. save, reset Use this
method in the entrance to snowy fields and you don't have to get off
the Chocobo. (You can even enter the cave with the Chocobo)
